actual_comparison: rustc execute_job_incr execution.rs405+ first demand-checks the existing stable query dep-node, not a driver phase key containing the complete new source content. graph.rs909+ recursively validates prior actual dependency edges, forces unknown/red dependencies when necessary, and excludes eval_always from blind green reuse.

graph.rs487 hashes actual computed query result and alloc_and_color_node graph.rs792+ marks a rerun green when result fingerprint is unchanged; downstream result equality can stop despite invalidated input. Query reads dynamically record actual dep-node edges graph.rs507. Query key fingerprint is separate stable key identity (dep_node_key.rs), with DefPath-style recoverable keys and opaque unrecoverable cases.

ZIL currently has analogous actual fine-result equality in Typed signatures, Analyze rows, Verify receipts, machine products and object/link bytes, often via direct bespoke sessions. Its outer whole-project DB key/digest deliberately binds complete raw construction and uses PrivateImplementation, so it lacks rustc-style stable-key red-green reuse at that coarse boundary. One centralized graph is not required; actual dependencies and consistent completed epochs are.

Rust Cargo freshness is a different unit layer: fingerprint/dependency output and mtime/dep-info conditions can avoid invoking rustc on unchanged inputs, but a private edit normally dirties the crate and reruns rustc. It is not per-function query scheduling.

Rust determine_cgu_reuse base.rs1238 requires existing work product plus green CompileCodegenUnit; it reuses whole post-LTO object/no-LTO or pre-LTO bitcode depending LTO. A changed CGU runs backend compilation again. It does not provide per-function defaultO2/MIR products inside a red CGU. Requested CGU16 is not a guarantee of16 nonempty units or stable same grouping.

Rust persisting graph/query cache still serializes metadata and retained query values; save.rs returns on errors before writing, and saves only after queries finish. Loaded-value fingerprint verification is sampled1/32 unless incremental_verify_ich, not a fresh independent compiler verifier on every cache load. Do not idealize Rust as cost-free perfect graph reuse or function-level LLVM optimization.
